description: Module for calculating maintenance respiration for coupled carbon-nitrogen dynamics in CTSM. Computes respiration fluxes for leaves, fine roots, live stems, live coarse roots, and reproductive tissues based on nitrogen content and temperature-dependent Q10 relationships.

fields.name: br
fields.description: Base rate for maintenance respiration (gC/gN/s) - default 2.525e-6 from Ryan 1991

fields.name: br_root
fields.description: Base rate for maintenance respiration for roots (gC/gN/s) - can differ from br for acclimation

parameters.name: sourcefile
parameters.description: Source file name for error reporting

parameters.name: Q10
parameters.description: Temperature sensitivity parameter for respiration. Originally 2.0, reduced to 1.5 for tuning atmospheric CO2 seasonal cycle

parameters.name: nrepr
parameters.description: Number of reproductive pools for crops

subroutines.name: CNMRespReadNML
subroutines.purpose: Read namelist parameters for maintenance respiration from input file. Must be called before readParams.

inputs.name: NLFilename
inputs.description: Path to namelist file

key_operations: Open namelist file on master processor
Search for 'cnmresp_inparm' namelist group
Read br_root parameter
Broadcast br_root to all processors via MPI
Store in params_inst module variable
Write settings to log

mpi_operations: shr_mpi_bcast(br_root, mpicom) - broadcast parameter to all processors

subroutines.name: readParams
subroutines.purpose: Read base respiration rate parameter from NetCDF parameter file. Must be called after CNMRespReadNML.

inputs.name: ncid
inputs.description: PIO NetCDF file descriptor

outputs: params_inst%br_root - set to br if not already set by namelist
key_operations: Read 'br_mr' variable from NetCDF file
Store in params_inst%br
If br_root not set by namelist (still spval), set to br
Error handling for missing parameters

conditionals: if (.not. readv) - check if variable was successfully read
if (params_inst%br_root == spval) - check if br_root needs default value

subroutines.name: CNMResp
subroutines.purpose: Calculate maintenance respiration fluxes for all live plant tissues (leaves, fine roots, live stems, live coarse roots, reproductive organs) based on nitrogen content and temperature-dependent Q10 relationships.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.description: Bounds for array indexing (begc, endc, begp, endp)

inputs.name: num_soilc
inputs.description: Number of soil columns in filter

inputs.name: filter_soilc
inputs.description: Column filter array for soil points

inputs.name: num_soilp
inputs.description: Number of soil patches in filter

inputs.name: filter_soilp
inputs.description: Patch filter array for soil points

inputs.name: canopystate_inst
inputs.description: Canopy state variables (LAI, vegetation fraction)

inputs.name: soilstate_inst
inputs.description: Soil state variables (root fraction by layer)

inputs.name: temperature_inst
inputs.description: Temperature variables (soil, 2m air, 10-day running mean)

inputs.name: photosyns_inst
inputs.description: Photosynthesis variables (leaf maintenance respiration rates, acclimation flag)

inputs.name: cnveg_nitrogenstate_inst
inputs.description: Vegetation nitrogen state (N content of tissues)

inputs.name: cnveg_carbonflux_inst
inputs.description: Vegetation carbon fluxes (maintenance respiration outputs)

outputs: livecroot_mr(p) - live coarse root maintenance respiration (gC/m2/s)
key_operations: Calculate Q10 temperature correction factors for each soil layer
Apply optional root/stem acclimation adjustment to base rates
Calculate leaf MR from photosynthesis module outputs (sunlit + shaded)
Calculate woody tissue MR (stem, coarse root) for trees
Calculate crop reproductive tissue MR for prognostic crops
Calculate fine root MR integrated over soil layers with depth-dependent temperature

loops.description: Loop over soil layers to calculate temperature corrections
Loop over filtered soil columns for temperature correction
Loop over filtered soil patches for leaf and woody tissue MR
Loop over soil layers for fine root MR calculation
Nested loop over patches within soil layer loop for fine root MR
Loop over reproductive pools for crop MR

filters: filter_soilc(fc) - column filter for active soil points
filter_soilp(fp) - patch filter for active soil points
conditionals: if (frac_veg_nosno(p) == 1) - check if vegetation not covered by snow
if (rootstem_acc) - check if root/stem acclimation is enabled
calculations: tcsoi(c,j) = Q10**((t_soisno(c,j)-SHR_CONST_TKFRZ - 20.0)/10.0) - soil layer temperature correction
leaf_mr(p) = lmrsun(p)*laisun(p)*12.011e-6 + lmrsha(p)*laisha(p)*12.011e-6 - leaf MR from photosynthesis
livestem_mr(p) = livestemn(p)*br*tc - stem MR from N content and temperature
froot_mr(p) = froot_mr(p) + frootn(p)*br_root*tcsoi(c,j)*crootfr(p,j) - fine root MR accumulated over layers

iteration_patterns: Filter-based iteration: Uses filter arrays (filter_soilc, filter_soilp) to iterate only over active soil points
Column-level: Temperature corrections calculated at column level for each soil layer
Patch-level: Most respiration calculations at patch level, accessing column data via patch%column(p)
Vertical integration: Fine root respiration integrates over soil layers using crootfr weights
aggregation_patterns: Fine root MR accumulated across soil layers: froot_mr(p) += contribution from each layer
Leaf MR aggregated from sunlit and shaded components
Temperature corrections applied at appropriate spatial level (column for soil, patch for air)

challenges: Filter-based iteration: Fortran uses dynamic filter arrays to iterate only over active points
Module-level state: params_inst is a module-level variable that persists across calls
MPI operations: Namelist reading and broadcasting requires MPI, not needed in JAX
NetCDF I/O: Parameter reading from file needs alternative approach
Associate blocks: Fortran's associate construct for aliasing variables
Nested loops with accumulation: Fine root MR accumulates over soil layers
Conditional tissue types: Different calculations for woody vs non-woody, crops vs non-crops
Array indexing: Fortran uses 1-based indexing, JAX uses 0-based
Optional acclimation: rootstem_acc flag changes calculation behavior
suggested_approach: Replace filters with boolean masks: Use jnp.where or boolean indexing instead of filter arrays
Use pytree/dataclass for parameters: Store params_inst as a frozen dataclass or dict
Remove MPI operations: Assume parameters are pre-loaded in Python driver
Pre-load parameters: Read NetCDF in Python initialization, pass as arguments
Explicit variable naming: Replace associate with explicit variable assignments or use dict unpacking
Use jnp.sum with axis: Replace accumulation loop with vectorized sum over soil layers
Use jnp.where for conditionals: Replace if statements with jnp.where for vectorization
Add offset in indexing: Subtract 1 from Fortran indices or use 0-based throughout
Use lax.cond or jnp.where: Handle acclimation flag with conditional execution
Vectorize over patches: Process all patches simultaneously using array operations

data_structure_mapping.params_type: Python dataclass or NamedTuple with br and br_root fields
data_structure_mapping.tcsoi(c,j): 2D JAX array (num_cols, nlevgrnd) for temperature corrections
data_structure_mapping.tissue nitrogen states: 1D JAX arrays (num_patches,) for each tissue type
data_structure_mapping.maintenance respiration outputs: 1D JAX arrays (num_patches,) for each tissue type
data_structure_mapping.reproductive_mr: 2D JAX array (num_patches, nrepr) for crop reproductive pools
data_structure_mapping.crootfr: 2D JAX array (num_patches, nlevgrnd) for root fraction by layer
data_structure_mapping.patch%column(p): 1D integer array (num_patches,) mapping patches to columns

vectorization_strategy.temperature_corrections: Vectorize over all columns and layers simultaneously: tcsoi = Q10**((t_soisno - TKFRZ - 20.0)/10.0)
vectorization_strategy.leaf_mr: Vectorize over all patches: leaf_mr = (lmrsun * laisun + lmrsha * laisha) * 12.011e-6 * frac_veg_nosno
vectorization_strategy.woody_tissue_mr: Use jnp.where with woody mask: livestem_mr = jnp.where(woody, livestemn * br * tc, 0.0)
vectorization_strategy.fine_root_mr: Use einsum or matrix multiply: froot_mr = frootn * br_root * jnp.sum(tcsoi[col_idx] * crootfr, axis=1)
vectorization_strategy.acclimation: Use lax.cond or jnp.where: br_adj = jnp.where(rootstem_acc, br * 10**(-0.00794*(t10-tfrz-25)), br)

special_considerations: Q10 value is tuned (1.5 not 2.0) - important for model calibration
Leaf MR comes from photosynthesis module, not calculated here - need to ensure consistency
Fine root MR integrates over soil layers with depth-dependent temperature - requires careful indexing
Acclimation is optional and experimental - may need to be configurable
Snow cover affects leaf MR (frac_veg_nosno) - binary flag in Fortran, could be continuous in JAX
Different PFT types have different tissue components - need PFT-aware masking
Conversion factor 12.011e-6 converts umol CO2/m2/s to gC/m2/s
Base rate from Ryan 1991 paper - well-established empirical relationship
testing_strategy: Unit test each tissue type MR calculation separately
Test temperature correction functions with known inputs
Verify Q10 relationship matches Fortran exactly
Test acclimation adjustment with and without flag
Verify fine root integration over soil layers
Compare outputs with Fortran for identical inputs
Test edge cases: zero nitrogen, extreme temperatures, snow cover

output_dependencies: All MR fluxes feed into carbon balance calculations downstream
Total plant respiration = sum of all tissue MR components
